title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
summary: An astronaut is left behind on Mars when his crew believes he is dead and has to evacuate. With almost no supplies, he must grow food, fix machinery and find a way to signal home.
readIf: you like problem-solving stories where a chatty hero science-hacks his way out of impossible spots.
skipIf: you want deep character drama, because the book is mostly engineering challenges and jokes.

pairings.reason: The same author, with the same funny, science-led voice, plus a bigger mystery and a surprise friendship.
A much quieter survival story about one person alone, with the same satisfaction in each small win.
Another sarcastic, nerdy narrator doing space problem-solving, with a lighter and weirder premise.
